answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the comet seed, the inlet timing is verifiable from the nebula record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 552 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is inexpensive once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 151 keys hence pays 151 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
